title: The Lost City
synopsis: A young cartographer follows a forgotten map to a city that vanished from every record.

chapters.title: The Map
chapters.content:
Mira found the map folded inside a book no one had borrowed in forty years.

The ink was still wet where it crossed the northern mountains, as if someone had drawn it that morning.

She packed a lantern, a compass and bread for three days, and left before the bells rang.

chapters.title: The Gate
chapters.content:
At dawn the mountains opened like a book. Between two walls of pale stone stood a gate with no hinges and no lock.

Mira laid her palm against it. The stone was warm, and somewhere behind it a city began to hum.
